Name: Lance Seasonal Alternative Outfits
Author: OwlRae6
Description:
First, a shoutout to my friend [b]@irrelevantx0x[/b] for the full art and @98_zelda for helping me with some of the pixel art, also [b]poltergeister[/b] for the seasonal outfits mod. Lastly, a special thank you to [b]FlashShifter[/b] for creating Stardew Valley Expanded Mod!

[b][u]To Use With Seasonal Outfits
[/u][/b]Simply Unzip the Seasonal Lance file
Open the extracted folder and copy the [b][u]assets[/u][/b] folders
Move over to the "Seasonal Cuter Characters Expanded" mod and hit paste
A message should pop up that says "the destination has files with the same names," and give you an option to[b][u] replace or skip[/u][/b] the files
Click the option to[u][b] replace[/b][/u] the files, and you're set 
It should only replace the[b][u] older versions[/u][/b] of [b][u]Lance's portraits and Sprites

To Use With Stardew Valley Expanded 
[/u][/b]Use the instructions mentioned above; it should be a similar experience to [b][u]Seasonal Outfits[/u][/b] :D
